states.title: States (optional)
states.description: Two-letter state codes to filter (e.g. "CA", "TX"). Leave empty for nationwide.

incidentTypes.title: Incident types (optional)
incidentTypes.description: Only include these incident types (e.g. "Fire", "Flood", "Hurricane", "Severe Storm(s)"). Leave empty for all types.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to include, by declaration date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of declarations to return, most recently declared first.
